content.value: Let us assume the following discount policy: Bookstores get a trade discount of 30%; for orders from libraries and individuals, 15% allowed on orders of(6-9) copies per book title; 18% on orders from (10-60) copies per book title; 25% on order for 61 copies or more per book title and on all the cases on order less then 6 copies no discount. Now draw the decision tree from the above information.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
